content:
lina: partner SI asked for a coordinated driver pin and smoke this Fri night. goal: limit reg risk, have automatic rollback, and give them a sanitized telemetry slice for correlation
rafael: which stack? cuda/driver/rocm versions?
lina: target: nvidia driver 535.86, CUDA 12.2. partner also runs a small RO Cm lab for customers on AMD, but this event is NV-focused
priya: ops availability? we can do 01:30-02:30 PT twilight. night-ops + marketplace infra on call. recommended: marketplace image pin, two-step canary (10 hosts then 100), smoke + perf compare, then fleet roll if green
tom: marketplace image pin workflow: create new image tag with driver bundle pinned. note: images must pass image-scan & signature before canary deploy
nitin: we saw kernel-ABI mismatches with 5.15->5.19 upgrades. recommend a kernel-ABI precheck probe before pin. if mismatch, abort and surface logs to partner
lina: good call. add precheck to plan. also partner asked for read-only telemetry in S3 for their trace IDs. security OK with sanitized slice but wants retention = 48h
rafael: add thresholds for auto-rollback: p99 token-latency increase > 20% OR error-rate > 0.3% OR host OOM events. if any, auto-rollback and alert
rollback-bot: auto-rollback policy saved: thresholds=[p99_latency:20%,error_rate:0.3%,oom_count:1], action=rollback-image
ci-bot: note: please attach perf baseline artifact id to the job. use artifact: perf-baseline-2026-03-20
priya: ops checklist draft: 
- create marketplace image tag (pin driver 535.86)
- run kernel-abi probe on canary hosts
- deploy to canary pool A (10 hosts)
- smoke tests: kvcache, token-latency, end-to-end generation
- perf collector -> compare vs baseline
- expose sanitized S3 prefix to partner (1h delay)
- if green -> expand to canary pool B (100 hosts)
- monitor 30m -> full roll or rollback
- post-run snapshot + export logs for postmortem

lina: timeline: planning notes by EOD Thu, partner signoff by 17:00 PT Thu, twilight window Fri 01:30-02:30 PT, post-mortem snapshot by 05:00 PT Fri
tom: comms draft for partner channel: "We will run a low-risk driver pin test during the agreed maintenance window. Expect brief traffic steering. We will auto-rollback on predefined regressions. We'll share sanitized traces for your triage." thoughts?
nitin: add explicit contact: "if urgent, escalate to nitin@redwood and the SI rep in thread"
rafael: also call out the perf thresholds in the comms, better than vague language
priya: added note: marketplace image build job will include vulnerability scan; if scan fails, job aborts and we notify partner immediately
lina: partner also asked about joint announcement timing if the test is fully successful. short answer: don't announce until we validate 48h of stable telemetry and legal signs off
rafael: agree. ops wants at least one successful daylight verification before any public mention
rollback-bot: incident channel template created: #ops-driver-pin-4381234567
ci-bot: build job queued: marketplace-pin-535-4381234567 [job-id: MB-2026-09]
priya: can someone own the telemetry export? I can create the S3 prefix and ACLs but need a list of trace IDs or spans to include
lina: partner will provide trace IDs after signoff. i'll collect and DM them to priya. include masking rules: remove PII, IPs, user ids
ritesh: (joining late) i'm oncall Fri night and can monitor the canary dashboards. ping me at start
lina: thanks. final ask: please keep run notes minimal and paste smoke command outputs into the incident channel. use code blocks for logs. example: 
```
# smoke run example
./smoke.sh --suite=kvcache,latency --threads=16 --duration=300
# perf compare
python perf_compare.py --baseline perf-baseline-2026-03-20 --current /tmp/run.json
```
priya: i'll post the ops checklist and image job link in this channel by EOD. everyone confirm availability?
rafael: yes
tom: yes
nitin: yes, will be oncall for partner comms
lina: thanks all. i'll lock the timeline once partner signs. closing for now, will reopen thread when job starts :white_check_mark:
